title: ID0409884-DC/Si-D/DK[PgPzOp] - EcoG SyntaxError: Unexpected token I in JSON in position 3686
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
StopTransactions are failing -
SyntaxError: Unexpected token I in JSON
Workaround:
Reboot charger/reboot EcoG
Final Solution
: TBD - R&D and EcoG involvement needed - Possible v8 fix only.
This charger has the same “SyntaxError: Unexpected token I in JSON”. We see the same symptoms that a reboot of the charger will fix the issue for some time, however it will return.

I do a scan of JSON errors on all DK chargers every morning.
